title: Workspace Overview
text: HelixCloud is a workspace platform for internal knowledge search, document chat, and agent-assisted support workflows.

title: Supported Regions
text: HelixCloud data residency is available in the United States, Germany, and Singapore for enterprise workspaces.

title: Authentication
text: Single sign-on with SAML is available on the Growth and Enterprise plans. Email and password login is available on every plan.

title: Role Permissions
text: Workspace owners can manage billing, security settings, and data retention. Admins can manage members and content sources, while analysts can run searches and export reports.

title: Audit Logs
text: Enterprise workspaces include audit logs for sign-in activity, source sync events, role changes, and report exports. Audit events are retained for 90 days.

title: Source Sync
text: Connected knowledge sources are re-indexed every 30 minutes on the Growth plan and every 5 minutes on the Enterprise plan.

title: File Upload Limits
text: HelixCloud supports PDF, DOCX, CSV, and TXT uploads up to 50 megabytes per file.

title: API Rate Limits
text: The public API allows 120 requests per minute per workspace token. Burst traffic above that limit receives HTTP 429 responses.

title: Webhook Delivery
text: Webhook notifications are retried up to five times with exponential backoff when a delivery endpoint returns a non-2xx response.

title: Data Retention
text: Deleted documents remain recoverable for 14 days before permanent removal. Workspace-level retention rules are available only on the Enterprise plan.

title: Model Support
text: Search answer generation supports GPT-4.1 mini, GPT-4.1, and locally hosted sentence-transformer rerankers.

title: Streaming Responses
text: Answer streaming is supported in the web app and the public API. Streaming is disabled automatically when a workspace enforces manual review mode.

title: Manual Review Mode
text: Manual review mode requires human approval before generated answers are shown to end users. It is designed for regulated support and legal review workflows.

title: Pricing Plans
text: The Starter plan includes up to 3 members, the Growth plan includes up to 25 members, and the Enterprise plan supports unlimited members with annual billing.

title: Support Coverage
text: Growth customers receive email support during business hours. Enterprise customers receive priority support with a four-hour first-response target.

title: Security Certifications
text: HelixCloud is SOC 2 Type II certified and encrypts data in transit and at rest.

title: Sandbox Environments
text: Enterprise workspaces can create one sandbox environment per production workspace for testing retrieval settings and prompt changes.

title: Analytics Exports
text: Search analytics can be exported as CSV from the web app. Scheduled exports are available only on the Enterprise plan.
